detail: F4 on the train-45 developer image (filled preset: development, 100000 transactions, 256 MiB history; heap re-decided by the image's own probe at each start, inside a 32G systemd scope): the owner accepted about 2,400 POSTs (2,102 colliding Message-IDs, shared-prefix IDs, reposts) with no refusal, then the restart under the same budget refused 'cold startup refused: the process heap does not hold the store's protected runtime' (hbox:/dev/shm/fn-load-f4e-t45/F4-image-x-r1/fault-0001/owner.{1,2}.err). The same store copy reopens outside that scope. Mechanism (S): the schema-3 checkpoint open re-interns every record with its payload into the heap arena (store-checkpoint-arena-load), while admission charges a POST's payload as a durable extent, not as heap. Required statement: every admitted POST keeps the open's own protected-runtime figure (the function the cold-startup check uses) within the running heap, or the POST is refused by name. Structural fix: S's paged checkpoint (s-pck-2c-host: payloads stay extents). Interim: S states the protected-runtime term in admission from the open's function. Tooth: L's cell F4R (bar P5-REOPEN-F4R: after a refusal-free first run, restart under the same heap and machine budget reaches LISTENING).
notes: 2026-10-08 (N): filed from L's F4; S joins on the store term.

10-08 13:16 S (s-admit-reopen) lane/s-admit-reopen@337b6c3f7, N ruling B: the :run heap is sized at observed nil (fn-heap-operation-observes-p false for :run; fn-heap-operation-observation nil for :run; status line routed through the predicate). KEYSTONE fn-heap-operation-figure-octets-of-a-run + fn-heap-run-figure-holds-every-later-open (with fn-heap-store-figure-observed-is-at-most-unobserved). Cause refined: tools/load/faults.py node() decides the heap ONCE on the empty store (heap_mode fixed) and reuses it at each restart; the empty store's open term is 0. Cost is reserved address space, not resident memory; RULINGS priority 1 outranks priority 3. Filled preset on the production core: 7,046,630,746 -> 7,867,993,434 octets, +821,362,688 (783.3 MiB; supersedes the 588 MiB first estimate). MB on the production core: small 498 -> 639, development 1330 -> 2489, scale 17748 -> 20402; small on the OpenBSD core 586 -> 728, on a 512 MiB core 958 -> 1090. Gates: certify --affected-by heap-figure green; interface_emit, keystone_emit 0 findings; host_check --load 0 findings. Owed: L F4R rerun; N image gate start_every_preset and image_floor 1024.
